parsed.summary: Router r2 serves as a gateway between the client segment and other network segments via eth1; it also connects to router r3 through eth4. It routes traffic destined for specific networks using static routing.

interfaces.name: eth2
interfaces.role: server-segment interface, possibly hosting services or applications accessible from other networks

interfaces.name: eth3
interfaces.role: management-segment for administrative access and monitoring purposes

interfaces.name: eth4
interfaces.role: link-to-r3, connecting to another router in the network topology

static_routes.purpose: reach the client segment via r1 (router connected through eth1)
reach additional network 10.0.3.0/24 using the same next-hop as client segment
route traffic to another router r3 connected through eth4 (router's IP)
